cases.title: Logout outcome clears client session and rejects subsequent authenticated API calls
preconditions: Student bearer token available from POST /v1/auth/login.
steps: Omit Authorization on GET /v1/me and POST /v1/check-ins probe.
cases.expected: BR-24 outcome: client session ended; API rejects requests without valid token; no privileged data returned after logout.

cases.title: M01 authenticate middleware rejects requests after logout credential discard
preconditions: Integration harness can invoke createAuthenticate middleware with and without bearer context.
steps: Bind valid actor to request via bearer token.
Simulate logout by removing Authorization on subsequent request to protected route preHandler.
Assert unauthenticated short-circuit before business logic.
cases.expected: Authentication guard enforces BR-24: cleared credentials yield 401 at middleware boundary without partial handler execution.
